description:
REVALIDATED 2026-08-20. Last PyPI release is v0.3.1 (2026-07-09). This clone is 1,247 commits ahead of that tag; PyPI last-month downloads 142; 11 stars / 0 forks.

This cut is the customer-visible lever, not changelog theater:
- docs.yml deploys GitHub Pages only on push to release, so cutting v0.4.0 is how https://benchbox.dev/results/ stops 404ing.
- Amendment 2026-08-13 + PR #1712 already made Results Explorer a curated-preview publication surface on release. The software is intended to ship with this cut.
- Isolated CLI first-60-seconds fix (docs.benchbox.dev NXDOMAIN; advertised `run -p` fails) should land in this wheel. It already exists as a98d20ca0 on docs/audit-v0-4-0; do not wait for the 94-file docs audit.

Stale planning: _project/planning/v0.4.0-release-readiness.md still says Results Explorer OUT OF SCOPE (2026-07-31). Reconcile that during w1.

Customer proof after w3: `pip install benchbox==0.4.0` works AND https://benchbox.dev/results/ returns 200. Release-gate configs do not substitute for those two checks. Cloud PLATFORM_GROUPS is not a gate for this cut.

anti_patterns.dont: Cut the release without a fresh qualifying release canary
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD require a green canary artifact bound to an ancestor of the release head
anti_patterns.why: docs/operations/release-guide.md makes canary freshness and ancestry blocking while UAT is advisory

anti_patterns.dont: Ship a wheel in which benchbox compare run mode still exits 0 on a fabricated 1.00x result
anti_patterns.why: the first thing a new user does is compare two engines

anti_patterns.dont: treat CHANGELOG triage or UAT release-gate evidence as the ship criterion
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD require pip install of 0.4.0 and live /results/ 200
anti_patterns.why: customers see PyPI and benchbox.dev, not those artifacts
